load_audio_from_url_or_path: load audio from a URL or local file path into a numpy array with a specified sampling rate
create_spectrogram_from_waveform: create a spectrogram from a single waveform using STFT with configurable window, frame length, and hop length
create_mel_filter_bank: create a mel filter bank matrix for converting a spectrogram to a mel spectrogram with configurable filter count and frequency range
convert_spectrogram_to_decibels: convert a power or amplitude spectrogram to decibel scale with configurable reference, minimum value, and dynamic range
compute_chroma_filter_bank: create a chroma filter bank matrix to project spectrogram bins onto chroma bins for pitch class analysis
